groups.stimulus: RJ has been found in possession of a commercial quantity of drugs. RJ, during questioning, denies the police questions that he knew of the existence of the drugs.

questions.stem: In an indictable criminal trial, what is one right of the defence?

options.A: To determine what evidence will be led by the prosecution
options.B: To decide what the charge is against the defendant
options.C: To determine who the judge is
options.D: To challenge evidence led by the prosecution

questions.stem: Who has the authority to decide on granting bail?
Which of the following rights is NOT in the United Nations Declaration of Human Rights?

options.A: The right to seek asylum from persecution

questions.stem: 20 year-old Gary is facing court on a charge of reckless driving. Who will represent the prosecution in the NSW Local Court?
What is the purpose of a Continued Detention Order?
Mark, aged 21 years, has been arrested after an armed robbery. How long can he be questioned for after the arrest?
What would be considered as evidence in a criminal trial?

options.A: An expert opinion of a doctor
options.B: An opinion of a radio host
options.C: An opinion of a Member of Parliament
options.D: An opinion of the United Nations

questions.stem: When can a young offender be found to be criminally responsible?

options.B: Between 10 years old and 14 years old if the prosecution rebuts doli incapax
options.C: When they reach the age of 16 years old
options.D: When they exceed the age of 18 years old

questions.stem: Which of the following human rights exist in the Australian Constitution?

options.C: The right to stand as a candidate for Parliament
options.D: The right to Legal Aid when tried for an indictable offence

questions.stem: What standard of proof must the prosecution meet if the matter is contested in court?
What can the police apply to RJ if a lawyer is present?

options.B: A promise that the court will approve lenient punishment for the offence
options.D: An order to remove the lawyer

questions.stem: What is one characteristic of human rights?

options.A: They only apply during times of conflict
options.D: The United Nations can enforce them

questions.stem: What legal concept is challenged by mandatory sentencing?
Electronic monitoring can form part of which of the following punishments?
Which of the following human rights bodies enforces human rights in Australia?
Who is responsible for granting parole to offenders in custody in NSW?
Antonia has been charged with murder. Which of the following is considered to be a complete defence available to her?
Which human right was enforced in Australia in 1901?

options.A: Universal suffrage for non-indigenous Australians aged 21 or older
options.B: The obligation to join a trade union
options.C: The right to unrestricted free speech

questions.stem: What does a guilty plea for a criminal offence remove from the criminal trial process?

options.B: The prior offences of the accused

questions.stem: Which of the following would be considered a crime prevention strategy?

options.A: School education visits from the police
